facilities.title: Integrated Psychiatric &
facilities.description:
Serenity Behavioral Services is an integrated psychiatric and behavioral health practice serving the Las Vegas community. We operate under licensed clinical and medical supervision to ensure structured, ethical, and evidence-based care.

Our multidisciplinary team works collaboratively to provide coordinated treatment planning, regulatory compliance, and continuity of care. We maintain a trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-focused approach while partnering with healthcare providers, case managers, and court systems to support long-term stability and measurable outcomes.

services.title: Comprehensive Treatment
services.description: From diagnostic evaluations to intensive outpatient programs, we provide a full continuum of evidence-based care tailored to each individual's needs.

evaluations.title: Mental Health Evaluations
evaluations.description: Comprehensive diagnostic assessments and court-referred evaluations. Clear, defensible documentation aligned with state and federal standards.

psychiatric.title: Psychiatric Evaluations
psychiatric.description: Clinical psychiatric assessments conducted under licensed medical supervision for diagnostic clarification and treatment planning.

courtReferred.title: Court-Referred Services
courtReferred.description: Evaluations and documentation designed for legal and probation requirements.

therapy.title: Individual/Group Therapy
therapy.description: Evidence-based individual and group counseling using a wide range of therapeutic modalities to address thinking patterns, emotional regulation, and lasting behavioral change.

iop.title: Intensive Outpatient Program
iop.description:
Serenity Behavioral Services offers an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) 12-week program, 3 days/week, 3 hours/session, in both in-person and Virtual to improve access to structured behavioral health care. We also provide transportation assistance for eligible clients to reduce barriers and support consistent participation.

Our IOP is designed for individuals needing a higher level of outpatient care or transitioning from inpatient or residential treatment. Through coordinated clinical oversight and structured programming, we focus on improving symptom stability, emotional regulation, and functional independence.

psr.title: Psychosocial Rehabilitation
psr.description: Skills-based, goal-oriented services to help individuals develop daily living, social, and coping skills for greater independence. 8-24-week program, 2-5 days/week, 1-4 hours/day.

trauma.title: Trauma-Focused Treatment
trauma.description: Specialized trauma-informed care including EMDR, TF-CBT, CPT, and stabilization strategies for PTSD, anxiety, and abuse survivors.

substance.title: Substance Use & Recovery
substance.description: Motivational Interviewing, relapse prevention, and harm reduction approaches to support long-term recovery and engagement.

telehealth.title: Telehealth Services
telehealth.description: HIPAA-compliant virtual treatment through the VSee platform, available for individual and group sessions when clinically appropriate.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, insurance, referrals, and treatment programs.

0.question: What types of insurance do you accept?
0.answer: We accept Medicare, Medicaid and select commercial insurance plans. Contact us to verify your specific coverage.

1.question: Do you accept court-referred or court-ordered clients?
1.answer: Yes. We specialize in court-referred evaluations and treatment, including DUI assessments, domestic violence programs, and mandated mental health treatment. Our documentation meets court compliance standards.

2.question: What is an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)?
2.answer: Our IOP provides structured treatment with multiple sessions per week for individuals who need more support than weekly therapy but do not require inpatient care. It focuses on symptom stabilization, coping skills, and behavioral regulation.

3.question: Do you offer telehealth services?
3.answer: Yes. We provide HIPAA-compliant telehealth services through the VSee platform for both individual and group sessions when clinically appropriate and Medicaid-approved.

4.question: How do I make a referral?
4.answer: You can refer a client by calling us at (702) 665-5035, emailing serenitybslv{'@'}gmail.com, or using our online contact form. We respond to all referrals promptly and begin the intake process immediately.

5.question: What evidence-based therapies do you use?
5.answer: Our clinicians use CBT, DBT, ACT, REBT, EMDR, Trauma-Focused CBT, Cognitive Processing Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, and Seeking Safety, among other validated approaches.
